training_source: Reused corrected 2048-pulse training checkpoints; no new learning and no tuning on probe outcomes.
fields: 20 paired seeds at each of low/medium/high noise; one deterministic quiet case.

true_input.expected_output: All128 true identities exactly once, in order, on all12 output lanes.

freeze: Both gains and b frozen throughout every test. q relaxed to0.1, E initially100. Original physical cost law retained.

conditions.ungated: Gains AND b trained without the READY gate; frozen. Whole learned-policy comparator, not a gain-only intervention.
conditions.uniform4: All gains4; normally learned b matched cell by cell.
conditions.uniform2: All gains2; normally learned b matched cell by cell.
conditions.directional: One central and one lateral gain from pooled training medians in CALIBRATION.json, applied everywhere; normally learned b.
conditions.directional_tail: Same median rule in layers7–130; retain normally learned gains in layers1–6 to control initial broadcast formation; normally learned b. Hybrid static comparator, not a fully homogeneous network.

static_selection: One pooled central median and one pooled lateral median from reachable ports of60 noisy normal training checkpoints; quiet excluded; chosen before tests. This specified rule is not claimed to be a globally optimal static design.

probes.layer7_time: Midpoint of the selected source gap +3 time units, plus the declared link jitter. No retiming after observing test outputs.
probes.lateral: Single input into layer7, lane j mod12, left port for j<12 and right port otherwise. Base amplitude0.5 or1.0; multiply by the same declared lognormal link field.
probes.central: Same schedule, layer7 central port, base amplitude0.5.
probes.noise: 24 sparse pulses at layer7, uniformly selected lane and port, base amplitude uniform[0.3,1.0], time offset uniform[-1,1] around scheduled midpoint+3; apply declared link amplitude/jitter field. Identical realization with and without true source. This is sparse pulse noise, not Gaussian continuous-current noise or a Poisson stream.
probes.wrong_lane: 24 canonical pulses on external source lane6 instead of lane0, at exact source-gap midpoints; amplitude1 before normal link noise.
probes.geometry: Layer7 targets structurally trained ports. Wrong-lane input separately probes the learned entrance geometry.
probes.timing_audit: Record whether each layer7 injection lies after the previous target true cohort ended and before the next began, when both cohorts exist. Never retime or silently discard violations.
probes.paired_randomness: Exactly the same source times, probe list and counter-based link noise field across conditions within each seed/level/scenario.

primary_endpoints.false_probe_reach_rate: Fraction of24 injected probe identities appearing in at least one output event at layer130. Mixed true/probe provenance counts as contamination, not as rejection.
primary_endpoints.true_recall: Fraction of128*12 expected true lane/identity pairs recovered exactly once in a pure true event, with no additional mixed/duplicate occurrence of that identity. Also report full_true_word and ordering.

provenance: Metadata only, not available to physical dynamics. At each firing, union the identities of currently active raw inputs. Retain unions through mixed events. This operational pulse-provenance measure is not a full counterfactual attribution of subthreshold charge memory. Report pure false and mixed event counts separately.
comparisons: Compare false reach and true recall jointly, paired by network seed; subtract each condition's clean recall to measure added damage. Never treat absence of statistical significance as equivalence.
exploratory_decision_rule: For a selective advantage over a comparator: paired95% interval for false-reach difference lies below0 AND lower endpoint for true-recall difference is above-0.001 (0.1 percentage point tolerance). Report full-word success separately. This is an explicitly chosen practical tolerance, not exact equality or a multiple-testing-adjusted confirmatory test.
statistics: Network-seed bootstrap,20000 paired resamples, deterministic RNG20261026;20 independent network seeds per noisy group. Do not treat individual probes or output lanes as independent seeds. Quiet is one example. Zero observed events does not prove zero population risk.
secondary_endpoints: first layer where each false identity appears or disappears
solver_scope: Existing nonoverlapping-auxiliary point solver, extended only with passive provenance sets. Any unsupported input overlap or other solver error stops certification of the dataset; no failing cases are dropped or counted as rejected probes.
scope: Functional selectivity test under this source geometry, sparse contamination and current cost law. No universal necessity, biological selectivity or hardware-energy claim.
